_comment: Business rules of the workflow automation (read by plan_agent AND by the Штурман server). Nothing here invents data: rules that are not approved stay disabled or 'propose'. See docs/WORKFLOW_AUTOMATION.md.
_stages_comment: Agent stage codes; the dashboard uses 'prototype' for 'test_prototype'.
_auto_assign_stage_comment: Master switch: false = the agent only proposes stages, nothing is assigned automatically.
_allow_backward_transitions_comment: Rework (e.g. measurement -> development) may be assigned automatically for agent-assigned stages; it is always recorded and reported as a warning.

stage_rules.description: In the project's latest engineering cycle, hours were logged (in progress) on main-stage activities of exactly ONE stage -> that stage is the current stage.
Hours were logged on activities of several stages -> the most advanced active stage is proposed; review.
All main activities of the latest cycle are verified completed -> the next stage of the workflow is proposed; review.

No work logged yet; this month's plan contains main-stage work of exactly ONE stage -> that stage is proposed. Switch mode to 'assign' only after the department approves that the month plan defines the current stage.
No work logged yet; the plan contains several stages -> the earliest planned stage is proposed; review.

activity_status._comment: Normalised activity status: planned | in_progress | completed | blocked | unknown. Hours are effort, never completion. ОК/NOK are kept as original values and are NOT interpreted until their meaning is confirmed.
activity_status._indicators_comment: Future verified indicators, e.g. {"field": "items_ok", "op": ">=", "value": 1} - empty until the department confirms what ОК / NOK mean. A status set manually in the dashboard (done / blocked) is always used as verified evidence.

next_action._generic_task_names_comment: A task named like this is described by its task group instead (e.g. «Прочее» in group «Выгрузка в PDM» -> «Выгрузка в PDM»).

priority._comment: Source priority = mapped Excel value (1/1.1/1.2/1.3 high, 2 normal, 3 low, 0/empty unspecified). System priority = result of the approved escalation rules below (none are approved yet, so the source priority is used). A manual priority in the dashboard always wins.

attention._comment: Indicators shown per project. Thresholds are null/empty until approved: then the indicator is reported as 'not configured', never guessed.

review._comment: Severity of review items created by the workflow automation: blocking (record not synchronised), review (a decision is needed), warning (informational, project processed). GET /api/review-queue returns blocking+review by default; ?severity=all returns everything.
